verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Gecko serves an llms.txt at gecko.security/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at docs.md (both HTTP 200). Its documentation pages are published as .md files, which agents can ingest directly, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: evidence of what the llms.txt covers (e.g., a full-docs llms-full.txt variant or documented structure), and independent user reports of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://gecko.security/llms.txt # Gecko Security
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://gecko.security/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
